slides.label: How to sell event tickets online
slides.title: Tickets that *sell themselves.*
slides.lede: Ticket types, group tickets, questions and coupons for your next fest.

slides.title: Plan three tickets
slides.text: Early bird with an end date, Regular, and a team ticket. The early bird stops selling on its own.

slides.title: Sell teams one ticket
slides.text: The lead pays once. Each member claims a seat and gets their own pass.

slides.title: Ask only what you'll use
slides.text: 14 question types. Choose if the lead answers or *every member does.*

slides.title: Give your club a code
slides.text: Percent or flat off, with a limit. When it's used up, it stops.

slides.title: Share one tracked link
slides.text: Attendees register and pay in the free Unifesto app and get a QR pass. You see which link sold.

slides.title: Open sales *this week.*
slides.lede: Free RSVP events cost nothing. Full video on our YouTube.
